title: Senior Solutions Architect
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Solutions Architect em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Senior Solutions Architect


Compensation: $6,800–$7,800 USD/month (depending on experience)

Engagement Type: Full-Time Contractor

Duration: 6–7 months with potential extension into a long-term support phase

Allocation: 100% Dedicated Engagement

Location: Remote (Americas) with periodic travel throughout the Americas and occasional travel to Europe.


About the Opportunity


Our client is a premium international hospitality organization operating a portfolio of luxury properties across North America, Latin America, and Europe. As part of a major data modernization initiative, they are building a centralized data platform that will consolidate operational, financial, guest, marketing, and commercial data from dozens of business-critical systems into a modern Microsoft Fabric environment.


They are seeking a Senior Solutions Architect to serve as the primary delivery lead for a large-scale enterprise integration program. This individual will work directly with executive stakeholders, business leaders, technology vendors, and engineering teams to define integration strategies, align business requirements, and drive successful execution across a complex multi-system ecosystem.


This role combines solution architecture, stakeholder management, vendor coordination, and delivery leadership, making it ideal for someone who enjoys bridging business objectives with technical implementation.


What You'll Do


  • Lead requirements discovery workshops with stakeholders across Finance, Operations, Sales, Marketing, CRM, and Business Intelligence teams.
  • Translate business objectives into scalable data integration and architecture solutions.
  • Serve as the primary client-facing delivery lead alongside a Fractional vCTO.
  • Coordinate with third-party software vendors to obtain integration requirements, negotiate technical specifications, and resolve implementation blockers.
  • Establish and maintain data requirements for each source system throughout the engagement lifecycle.
  • Collaborate with downstream analytics and modeling partners to define data warehouse consumption requirements.
  • Drive project planning, status reporting, stakeholder communications, and executive updates.
  • Produce key discovery-phase deliverables, including source system assessments, integration recommendations, implementation roadmaps, and vendor evaluations.
  • Help shape architecture decisions for a modern enterprise data platform built on Microsoft Fabric and Azure technologies.


What We're Looking For


Required Qualifications


  • 8+ years of experience in Solutions Architecture, Data Architecture, or Enterprise Integration leadership roles.
  • Proven experience leading large-scale data integration initiatives involving numerous business systems and stakeholders.
  • Hands-on architecture experience with Microsoft Fabric, Azure data services, or comparable cloud data platforms.
  • Strong background facilitating requirements gathering with executive stakeholders and operational leaders.
  • Experience working directly with third-party SaaS vendors to define and negotiate integration approaches.
  • Deep understanding of data warehouse architecture, governance, data contracts, and scalable ingestion patterns.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Professional-level English proficiency.


Preferred Qualifications


  • Experience delivering technology solutions within hospitality, retail, multi-location, or franchise-based organizations.
  • Familiarity with hospitality technology ecosystems, property management systems, POS platforms, CRM solutions, HRIS platforms, or reservation systems.
  • Consulting experience with a systems integrator, Microsoft partner, advisory firm, or enterprise consulting organization.
  • Microsoft certifications such as Azure Solutions Architect, Fabric Analytics Engineer, or similar.
  • Spanish and/or Italian language skills are highly valued.


Technical Environment


The engagement leverages a modern Microsoft data stack, including:

  • Microsoft Fabric (Lakehouse, Warehouse, Data Factory, OneLake)
  • Azure ecosystem services
  • REST, SOAP, SFTP, and CDC integration patterns
  • Enterprise SaaS and hospitality platforms
  • Large-scale data ingestion and warehouse architectures


Team Structure


You will report directly to the engagement's Fractional vCTO and collaborate with a senior delivery team that includes Data Engineering, Backend/DevOps, and hospitality domain specialists. Together, the team is responsible for delivering a high-impact enterprise data platform that will support strategic decision-making across a global hospitality operation.


Why Join?


This is a unique opportunity to lead a highly visible enterprise transformation initiative for a sophisticated international organization. You'll work directly with senior leadership, influence architecture decisions, and help build a modern data foundation that will power business operations across multiple countries and brands.

title: Remote Mathematics Expert
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Remote Mathematics Expert em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Role Overview:

We are seeking highly skilled and motivated mathematicians with a strong understanding of intermediate to advanced mathematical concepts and the ability to apply these concepts creatively to complex problems. This role is ideal for individuals who thrive in tackling challenging questions and have a passion for deep mathematical reasoning and problem-solving. We are hiring both individuals who are strong in undergraduate level mathematics and as well as those who are strong in masters/PhD level mathematics. Turing works with most of the leading LLM companies in the world today and your work will enable today’s leading LLMs to attain advanced mathematics proficiency.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop and implement advanced mathematical models and computational techniques to address complex problems across diverse mathematical domains.
  • Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams on research initiatives, providing mathematical expertise and analytical insights.
  • Review and engage with the latest mathematical literature, including cutting-edge research papers and emerging methodologies.
  • Apply quantitative and computational approaches to analyze data, optimize models, and support innovative problem-solving strategies.
  • Contribute to the advancement of research projects through rigorous mathematical reasoning and technical proficiency.


Desired Skills and Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s, Master’s, or PhD degree in Mathematics or a closely related field, with strong expertise in one or more of the following areas: computable functions and mathematical logic, algebra and number theory, linear algebra and matrix theory, topology and geometry, real analysis, probability, and statistics.
  • Proven ability to solve complex mathematical problems, demonstrated through research experience, publications, academic achievements, or project work.
  • Knowledge of Python and data analysis tools is preferred, though not mandatory.
  • Excellent analytical and critical thinking skills, with strong attention to detail and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain complex mathematical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Collaborative mindset with experience working in multidisciplinary teams on research-driven or project-based initiatives.


More details on required skills:

Candidates should demonstrate strong expertise in at least 4 of the following 7 domains, with broader coverage considered a significant advantage:

Computable Functions and Mathematical Logic

  • Strong understanding of the theory of computation, computable functions, decision problems, and strategies for inferring functions from input-output relationships.

Algebra and Number Theory

  • Deep knowledge of algebraic structures, quadratic forms, signatures, prime numbers, Eisenstein series, and related concepts in number theory and their applications.

Linear Algebra and Matrix Theory

  • Proficiency in linear spaces, basis transformations, symmetric matrices, matrix equations, matrix diagonalization, and rank-related conditions.

Topology and Geometry

  • Understanding of vector bundles, cohomology, fundamental groups, commensurability, topological spaces, vector fields, and geometric proof techniques.

Analysis

  • Strong foundation in real analysis, including properties of functions almost everywhere, convergence concepts, continuity, and advanced analytical reasoning.

Probability and Statistics

  • Ability to apply probability theory to evaluate outcomes under varying conditions, along with experience using statistical techniques such as ANOVA for experimental and data analysis.

Applied Mathematics

  • Capability to apply mathematical reasoning and problem-solving techniques to practical scenarios, including logic-based and analytical challenges.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and up to 40 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST.
  • Engagement type: Contractor


Evaluation Process:

  • Shortlisted candidates will be sent a Job Interest Form.
  • After the profile review, an assessment will be shared, which must be completed within 24 hours.
  • Based on the assessment outcomes, shortlisted candidates will be contacted to schedule an interview.


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

Company Description

Metrobi is a fulfillment platform designed to support local businesses, particularly in industries like food and beverage. The company simplifies delivery management by connecting businesses with local contractor drivers and optimizing in-house delivery operations. Through its logistics, financial, and marketing tools, Metrobi empowers local businesses to confidently grow their distribution networks.   • Prior experience in a similar role is preferred.
  • Skills like SQL, Git, reading Python code and doing data analysis are very beneficial, but not required


Notes

  • This is a full-time remote position.
  • Hiring interviews are online.

description:

About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Role Overview:

The Mathematical Systems & Abstract Reasoning Engineer is responsible for developing advanced reasoning datasets that evaluate and improve the capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs). This role involves designing novel mathematical systems, defining custom rules and axioms, and creating rigorous reasoning challenges that require models to interpret definitions, perform symbolic computations, derive properties, and construct logically sound proofs. The ideal candidate combines deep expertise in abstract mathematics with exceptional analytical and communication skills to produce self-contained, verifiable, and high-quality evaluation tasks.

What does day-to-day look like:

  • PhD / Doctorate

  • Authored multi-step reasoning tasks involving symbolic manipulation, expression evaluation, and proof-based problem solving.
  • Developed deterministic solutions, detailed reasoning traces, and comprehensive scoring rubrics for model assessment.
  • Identified and addressed edge cases, ambiguities, and logical inconsistencies to ensure task robustness and reproducibility.
  • Collaborated with reviewers and AI/LLM teams to refine task definitions, evaluation criteria, and dataset quality standards.


Required Qualifications:

  • Strong foundation in abstract mathematics, formal logic, algebraic structures, discrete mathematics, or theoretical computer science.
  • Minimum 2 years of experience in mathematics, computer science, data science, logic, or a related analytical discipline.
  • Proven ability to create structured reasoning problems that assess both conceptual understanding and procedural accuracy.

title: Product Owner
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Product Owner em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Company Description

Metrobi is a fulfillment platform designed to support local businesses, particularly in industries like food and beverage. The company simplifies delivery management by connecting businesses with local contractor drivers and optimizing in-house delivery operations. Through its logistics, financial, and marketing tools, Metrobi empowers local businesses to confidently grow their distribution networks. Metrobi operates with a mission to enhance efficiency and scale for local makers and distributors.


Intro video:


Responsibilities

  • Backlog & Kanban Management:

Own the Kanban board: organize tasks, ensure priorities are clear and understand what is stopping us from maintaining our task flow to hit our deployment goals. Communicate risks, issues, blockers, and quality concerns to the PM and relevant team members.

  • Task Definition & Refinement:

Review and write descriptions for tasks about new features, improvements and bug fixes. Ensure problems are well explained and solutions are testable and aligned with product goals. Collaborate with the Product Manager to translate strategy into actionable tasks.

  • Validate Outcomes, Not Just Output:

After new features or fixes go live, verify whether they truly solved the original problem and improved the targeted user or business metrics.


Qualifications

  • Strong skills in Product Management and Business Analysis to define and evaluate product requirements effectively.
  • Excellent Communication skills for collaborating with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
  • Familiarity with Software Development processes and tools to coordinate effectively with technical teams.
  • Ability to adapt in a dynamic, fast-paced working environment and manage multiple priorities.
  • Prior experience in a similar role is preferred.
  • Skills like SQL, Git, reading Python code and doing data analysis are very beneficial, but not required


Notes

  • This is a full-time remote position.
  • Hiring interviews are online.

title: Marketing and Communications Coordinator
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Marketing and Communications Coordinator em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Company Description Hjelle Consulting Group (HCG) is a specialized network of regulatory affairs, regulatory science, and product pipeline design experts serving the agricultural technology sector. Led by former Monsanto Regulatory Vice President Jerry Hjelle, the team includes experienced strategists, scientists, and government affairs professionals with deep expertise across plant and on-plant products, including gene-edited crops, biotech plants, agricultural chemistries, microbials, and biologicals. HCG aims to deliver top-tier regulatory expertise and execution that has traditionally been available only to large multinational companies, and at a more accessible cost. Through a “Regulatory on Demand” model, HCG helps clients scale strategic and execution support as needed, reducing the burden of building in-house regulatory teams. The company’s ongoing engagement with client product pipelines also provides investors with confidence in the quality, design, and capital efficiency of the regulatory work supporting those products.


Role Description Hjelle Consulting Group (HCG) is seeking an experienced Marketing & Communications Coordinator on a contract basis to support our growing thought leadership program in agricultural biotechnology regulation. This is a remote, operational role — you will own the execution of our content distribution, email marketing (Brevo), LinkedIn scheduling, and webinar coordination, working directly with senior regulatory scientists to extract and amplify their expertise to a global B2B audience. The ideal candidate has hands-on experience in agbiotech, agricultural inputs, or regulatory affairs marketing, writes and communicates with precision in English, and thrives in a lean, self-directed environment where building systems matters as much as executing them. Portuguese proficiency is a plus. If you have managed marketing operations for a technical B2B firm and understand what it means to communicate credibly to scientists, regulators, and investors — we want to hear from you.

You will work closely with voice artists, agencies, and internal teams to ensure all audio content aligns with scripts, quality guidelines, and storytelling objectives.


Key Responsibilities


1. Audio Quality Control (Raw & Mastered Files)

  • Review raw voice-over recordings to ensure clarity, acting, delivery, pronunciation, tone, pacing, and adherence to script.
  • Evaluate mastered audio files (SFX + background music) for overall listening experience, sound ambiences, balance, and quality standards.
  • Ensure all audio assets meet defined QC guidelines and Specs before approval.


2. Script-to-Audio Alignment

  • Verify that audio delivery accurately follows the approved script, including dialogue, tone, and emotional expression.
  • Identify and flag mismatches, missing lines, or deviations in narration.


3. Technical & Creative Accuracy

  • Check audio for:
  • Voice clarity and consistency
  • Emotional delivery and storytelling effectiveness
  • Background noise or distortions
  • Timing and pacing issues
  • Proper integration of SFX and music in mastered files
  • Grammatically incorrect words/sentences
  • Physical noise of voice artist
  • Abrupt cut / jerk
  • Sibilance
  • Fumble / mumble


4. Vendor & Artist Coordination

  • Collaborate with voice-over artists and external agencies to communicate QC feedback.


  • Ensure timely implementation of revisions and re-submissions.


5. QC Documentation & Tracking

  • Provide detailed QC feedback at timecode (TC) level.
  • Update QC comments and statuses in internal tools or Excel trackers based on show type (AI and PGC content).
  • Maintain records for submissions, revisions, approvals, and delivery timelines.


6. Pre-Release Quality Checks

  • Ensure all audio files are QC-approved before publishing or release on the platform.
  • Validate that final output meets both technical and creative standards.


7. Cross-Team Collaboration

  • Work closely with writers, production teams, post production agencies, and content managers to ensure seamless audio quality.
  • Align with internal guidelines and storytelling expectations across shows.


8. Process Improvement

  • Identify recurring audio quality issues across voice artists or agencies.
  • Recommend improvements to QC processes, guidelines, and production workflows.
  • Understand how an audience reacts to certain genres of content to connect with the audience
  • Stay abreast with changes in the voice requirements and technology


9. Volume & Deadline Management

  • Handle QC for approximately 80 hours of audio content within defined timelines.
  • Maintain high-quality standards while managing large volumes of content.


10. AI Voice Quality Review & Enhancement

Review AI-generated voice content to identify issues impacting listener experience, including but not limited to:

  • Accent inconsistencies and unnatural speech patterns
  • Mispronunciations and incorrect word stress
  • Lack of emotion, expression, or character differentiation
  • Robotic delivery, pacing irregularities, or unnatural pauses
  • Voice continuity and tonal inconsistencies across episodes
  • Contextually inappropriate emphasis or dialogue delivery


Perform basic audio patchwork and corrective edits using approved audio editing tools to address identified issues wherever feasible.


Document AI voice-related observations with clear, actionable feedback at the time-code level and track recurring issues to support model improvements and production quality enhancements.


Collaborate with AI production, content, and post-production teams to ensure continuous improvement in AI-generated audio quality and listener engagement.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Audio Engineering, Media, Communications, or a related field.
  • Strong understanding of audio production, voice modulation, and sound design basics.
  • Experience in audio quality control, podcast production, or voice-over review is preferred.
  • Familiarity with audio editing tools (Audition, Audacity, or similar) is a plus.
  • Ability to review both AI-generated and professionally generated (PGC) content.
  • Excellent attention to detail and auditory judgment.
  • Strong organizational and documentation skills.
  • Ability to coordinate with multiple stakeholders in a fast-paced production environment.
  • Proficiency in audio editing tools such as Adobe Audition, Audacity, or similar software for basic audio corrections and patchwork.


Language requirements

  • Fluent Portugese
  • Professional working proficiency in English


This role will be working with stakeholders in English on a regular basis.


Salary for this position is R$ $3800 - $4100 BRL.

title: Senior Solutions Architect
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Solutions Architect em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Senior Solutions Architect


Compensation: $6,800–$7,800 USD/month (depending on experience)

Engagement Type: Full-Time Contractor

Duration: 6–7 months with potential extension into a long-term support phase

Allocation: 100% Dedicated Engagement

Location: Remote (Americas) with periodic travel throughout the Americas and occasional travel to Europe.


About the Opportunity


Our client is a premium international hospitality organization operating a portfolio of luxury properties across North America, Latin America, and Europe. As part of a major data modernization initiative, they are building a centralized data platform that will consolidate operational, financial, guest, marketing, and commercial data from dozens of business-critical systems into a modern Microsoft Fabric environment.


They are seeking a Senior Solutions Architect to serve as the primary delivery lead for a large-scale enterprise integration program. This individual will work directly with executive stakeholders, business leaders, technology vendors, and engineering teams to define integration strategies, align business requirements, and drive successful execution across a complex multi-system ecosystem.


This role combines solution architecture, stakeholder management, vendor coordination, and delivery leadership, making it ideal for someone who enjoys bridging business objectives with technical implementation.


What You'll Do


  • Lead requirements discovery workshops with stakeholders across Finance, Operations, Sales, Marketing, CRM, and Business Intelligence teams.
  • Translate business objectives into scalable data integration and architecture solutions.
  • Serve as the primary client-facing delivery lead alongside a Fractional vCTO.
  • Coordinate with third-party software vendors to obtain integration requirements, negotiate technical specifications, and resolve implementation blockers.
  • Establish and maintain data requirements for each source system throughout the engagement lifecycle.
  • Collaborate with downstream analytics and modeling partners to define data warehouse consumption requirements.
  • Drive project planning, status reporting, stakeholder communications, and executive updates.
  • Produce key discovery-phase deliverables, including source system assessments, integration recommendations, implementation roadmaps, and vendor evaluations.
  • Help shape architecture decisions for a modern enterprise data platform built on Microsoft Fabric and Azure technologies.


What We're Looking For


Required Qualifications


  • 8+ years of experience in Solutions Architecture, Data Architecture, or Enterprise Integration leadership roles.
  • Proven experience leading large-scale data integration initiatives involving numerous business systems and stakeholders.
  • Hands-on architecture experience with Microsoft Fabric, Azure data services, or comparable cloud data platforms.
  • Strong background facilitating requirements gathering with executive stakeholders and operational leaders.
  • Experience working directly with third-party SaaS vendors to define and negotiate integration approaches.
  • Deep understanding of data warehouse architecture, governance, data contracts, and scalable ingestion patterns.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Professional-level English proficiency.


Preferred Qualifications


  • Experience delivering technology solutions within hospitality, retail, multi-location, or franchise-based organizations.
  • Familiarity with hospitality technology ecosystems, property management systems, POS platforms, CRM solutions, HRIS platforms, or reservation systems.
  • Consulting experience with a systems integrator, Microsoft partner, advisory firm, or enterprise consulting organization.
  • Microsoft certifications such as Azure Solutions Architect, Fabric Analytics Engineer, or similar.
  • Spanish and/or Italian language skills are highly valued.


Technical Environment


The engagement leverages a modern Microsoft data stack, including:

  • Microsoft Fabric (Lakehouse, Warehouse, Data Factory, OneLake)
  • Azure ecosystem services
  • REST, SOAP, SFTP, and CDC integration patterns
  • Enterprise SaaS and hospitality platforms
  • Large-scale data ingestion and warehouse architectures


Team Structure


You will report directly to the engagement's Fractional vCTO and collaborate with a senior delivery team that includes Data Engineering, Backend/DevOps, and hospitality domain specialists. Together, the team is responsible for delivering a high-impact enterprise data platform that will support strategic decision-making across a global hospitality operation.


Why Join?


This is a unique opportunity to lead a highly visible enterprise transformation initiative for a sophisticated international organization. You'll work directly with senior leadership, influence architecture decisions, and help build a modern data foundation that will power business operations across multiple countries and brands.

title: Analista de Suporte e Integrações MFT / SWIFT
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Analista de Suporte e Integrações MFT / SWIFT em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade .

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


O que estamos buscando

Um(a) profissional com perfil técnico, analítico e colaborativo para atuar no desenvolvimento, suporte e monitoramento de integrações utilizando MOVEit e SWIFT, em um ambiente dinâmico e global.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver e manter integrações utilizando MOVEit e SWIFT.
  • Atuar no suporte e troubleshooting de integrações em produção, tanto on-premises quanto em cloud.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com parceiros externos e áreas internas para implementação de integrações conforme necessidade dos clientes.
  • Monitorar transações via SWIFT Alliance Cloud e dashboards do MOVEit Automation.
  • Resolver incidentes rapidamente em parceria com back office, instituições bancárias e parceiros externos.
  • Realizar melhorias contínuas e mudanças na plataforma.
  • Criar e manter scripts e ferramentas de apoio às operações da equipe.
  • Promover documentação técnica e transferência de conhecimento entre os membros do time.


Requisitos Técnicos Obrigatórios

  • Conhecimento em topologias de rede e protocolos/serviços como:
  • DNS
  • HTTPS/API
  • SSH
  • FTPS/SFTP
  • SMTP
  • Experiência básica com administração de Windows Server e PowerShell.
  • Conhecimento em APIs (consumo e gerenciamento).
  • Conhecimento em Azure Administration, incluindo configuração de objetos, políticas e controles de segurança.
  • Conhecimento em autenticação OAuth2 e mecanismos de integração e acesso.
  • Boa lógica de programação.
  • Experiência com suporte e monitoramento de aplicações.
  • Forte capacidade analítica e resolução de problemas.


Idioma

  • Inglês avançado/fluente (leitura, escrita e conversação obrigatórios).


Diferenciais

  • Experiência prévia com MOVEit, SWIFT ou integrações financeiras.
  • Vivência em ambientes corporativos críticos e de alta disponibilidade.

title: Remote Physics Expert
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Remote Physics Expert em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.


Role Overview:

  • Design and solve challenging Physics problems to evaluate and identify the limitations of large language models.
  • Develop clear, high-quality, step-by-step solutions with precise and well-articulated reasoning.
  • Collaborate closely with LLM researchers to align problem design with evaluation objectives, particularly in areas where models typically struggle, such as abstraction, multi-step reasoning, and symbolic manipulation.
  • Contribute to the development of new evaluation benchmarks based on Physics curricula ranging from early undergraduate concepts to advanced PhD-level topics.
  • Analyze model outputs, identify reasoning gaps, and provide insights to improve model accuracy and performance.
  • Support the advancement of AI research by combining domain expertise in Physics with analytical and problem-solving methodologies.


Requirements :

  • Analytical Skills: Strong research and analytical abilities, with the capability to evaluate complex information and identify meaningful insights.
  • Feedback Skills: Ability to provide constructive feedback, detailed annotations, and clear evaluations to support continuous improvement.
  • Creative Thinking: Strong creative and lateral thinking skills, with the ability to approach problems from multiple perspectives and develop innovative solutions.
  • Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively in a remote and cross-functional environment.
  • Independence: Self-motivated, proactive, and capable of working independently while managing tasks and deadlines efficiently in a remote setting.
  • Technical Setup: Access to a reliable desktop or laptop and a stable high-speed internet connection to support remote collaboration and project work.


Preferred Qualification:

  • Candidates who have completed a Master’s, Ph.D., or Postdoctoral degree in Physics, Applied Physics, or a closely related field are eligible and strongly encouraged to apply.
  • Strong ability to analyze and solve complex Physics problems using a structured, logical, and methodical approach.
  • Ability to explain Physics concepts clearly and effectively through simplified explanations, visual representations, and strong conceptual reasoning.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and up to 40 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST.
  • Engagement type: Contractor


Evaluation Process:

  • Shortlisted candidates will be sent a Job Interest Form.
  • After the profile review, an assessment will be shared, which must be completed within 24 hours.
  • Based on the assessment outcomes, shortlisted candidates will be contacted to schedule an interview.


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Remote Mathematics Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Remote Mathematics Specialist em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


Role Overview:

The Mathematical Systems & Abstract Reasoning Engineer is responsible for developing advanced reasoning datasets that evaluate and improve the capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs). This role involves designing novel mathematical systems, defining custom rules and axioms, and creating rigorous reasoning challenges that require models to interpret definitions, perform symbolic computations, derive properties, and construct logically sound proofs. The ideal candidate combines deep expertise in abstract mathematics with exceptional analytical and communication skills to produce self-contained, verifiable, and high-quality evaluation tasks.

What does day-to-day look like:

  • PhD / Doctorate
  • Designed and defined novel mathematical systems, operations, and axiomatic frameworks for reasoning evaluations.
  • Authored multi-step reasoning tasks involving symbolic manipulation, expression evaluation, and proof-based problem solving.
  • Developed deterministic solutions, detailed reasoning traces, and comprehensive scoring rubrics for model assessment.
  • Identified and addressed edge cases, ambiguities, and logical inconsistencies to ensure task robustness and reproducibility.
  • Collaborated with reviewers and AI/LLM teams to refine task definitions, evaluation criteria, and dataset quality standards.


Required Qualifications:

  • Strong foundation in abstract mathematics, formal logic, algebraic structures, discrete mathematics, or theoretical computer science.
  • Minimum 2 years of experience in mathematics, computer science, data science, logic, or a related analytical discipline.
  • Proven ability to create structured reasoning problems that assess both conceptual understanding and procedural accuracy.
  • Excellent written communication skills with the ability to document rigorous definitions, proofs, and reasoning processes.
  • Experience evaluating LLM reasoning performance or developing AI training and assessment datasets is preferred.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required : 4 hours of overlap with PST.
  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of contract : 8 weeks.

title: Solutions Architect
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Solutions Architect em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

At Sisense, we help organizations turn complex data into actionable intelligence. As a Senior Solution Architect, you will play a critical role in designing, implementing, and optimizing enterprise-grade analytics deployments for customers with complex technical and business needs. You will partner closely with customers, internal stakeholders, and product teams to ensure successful outcomes across architecture, deployment, scalability, and long-term value realization.


Employment Type : Full-time position employed by a partner agency (3rd party, B2B)


WHY JOIN OUR SOLUTION ARCHITECT TEAM?

  • You will work at the intersection of customer success, cloud architecture, and data platforms.
  • You will help customers solve complex infrastructure, deployment, and performance challenges across Sisense environments.
  • You will collaborate with Product, R&D, Support, and Customer Success to shape best practices and improve the platform.
  • You will influence architecture decisions for strategic customers and high-visibility engagements.


IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL:

  • Lead custom multi-node Linux installations and upgrades for Sisense deployments, including troubleshooting complex deployment issues.
  • Own and troubleshoot multi-node Windows-to-Linux migration projects, backup and restore processes, and architecture-related escalations.
  • Perform load testing, interpret results, and provide strategic recommendations for scaling, performance, and resource optimization.
  • Analyze logs, system performance, and infrastructure telemetry to proactively identify risks and optimize customer environments.
  • Partner with customer Application Developers, DevOps, IT teams, and executive sponsors to drive successful outcomes.
  • Act as the voice of the customer by sharing product feedback, submitting bugs and feature requests, and influencing roadmap priorities.
  • Lead enablement for internal teams, mentor Solution Architects, and support technical interviews for new hires.


WHAT YOU’VE ACCOMPLISHED… SO FAR:

  • 5+ years of related experience in customer-facing technical roles, with prior experience as a Solution Architect.
  • Hands-on expertise with Linux (Ubuntu, Amazon Linux, RHEL/CentOS), Kubernetes, Docker, Helm, and cloud platforms such as AWS EKS / GKE.
  • Strong experience troubleshooting distributed systems, networking, security, and system monitoring tools such as Grafana and Coralogix.
  • Advanced working knowledge of MongoDB (or another NoSQL database), including query optimization and troubleshooting.
  • Intermediate SQL skills with the ability to join data across disparate sources and optimize queries.
  • Proficiency in scripting and coding with Bash, Python, JavaScript, and CSS.
  • Experience with load testing tools such as K6 and with modern cloud data warehouse technologies (Snowflake, Redshift, BigQuery) is a plus.
  • Strong customer communication skills, with the ability to engage technical teams and executive stakeholders.


HOW YOU’LL RAMP:

  • By Day 30: Build a strong understanding of Sisense architecture, deployment models, product capabilities, and customer engagement processes.
  • By Day 60: Independently lead standard and custom deployment activities, troubleshoot escalations, and support customer architecture reviews.
  • By Day 90: Own complex technical engagements end-to-end, mentor junior team members, and contribute to internal best practices and enablement.

title: Solutions Architect | Data & AI (Presales)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Solutions Architect | Data & AI (Presales) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Avenue Code is the leading software consultancy focused on delivering end-to-end development solutions for digital transformation across every vertical. We’re privately held, profitable, and have been on a solid growth trajectory since day one. We care deeply about our clients, our partners, and our people. We prefer the word ‘partner’ over ‘vendor’, and our investment in professional relationships is a reflection of that philosophy. We pride ourselves on our technical acumen, our collaborative problem-solving ability, and the warm professionalism of our teams.


About the Opportunity:

As a Solutions Architect specialized in Data & AI, you will be responsible for driving business growth, expanding our market share, and accelerating our strategic partnership with Google Cloud.


This is a highly strategic, technical-commercial role. You will act as the trusted advisor for our clients, identifying new business opportunities, understanding complex business challenges, and architecting customized Google Cloud Data & AI solutions. Your ultimate goal is to bridge the gap between technical excellence and business value, presenting high-impact pitches to C-level executives to close deals and maximize Google Cloud adoption.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Business Development & Pipeline Growth: Identify, qualify, and develop new business opportunities for Data and Generative AI solutions within our Google Cloud ecosystem.
  • Google Partnership Alignment: Work closely with Google Cloud’s internal sales and technical teams (Partner Managers, Account Executives, and CE/CEs) to co-sell, align strategies, and map target accounts.
  • Executive Pitching & Value Selling: Lead discovery sessions and deliver compelling technical-commercial pitches to C-Level executives (CDO, CIO, CTO, CMO), translating complex technical architectures into clear business outcomes, ROI, and strategic value.
  • Solution Architecture & Prototyping: Design high-level, customized data architectures and coordinate rapid Proof of Concepts (PoCs) on Google Cloud to validate value and accelerate the client’s buying decision.
  • Proposal & RFP Leadership: Own the technical-commercial strategy for complex proposals and RFPs, defining the scope, commercial engineering, and value proposition of the proposed Google Cloud solution.
  • Advanced English


Required Qualifications:

  • Proven BDM or Technical Pre-Sales Experience: Solid track record in Business Development, Technical Sales, or Solution Architecture within the IT/Cloud Consulting industry, specifically driving cloud revenue.
  • Google Cloud Ecosystem Expertise: Deep knowledge of Google Cloud's data portfolio (BigQuery, Cloud Composer, Dataproc, Pub/Sub, Dataflow).
  • AI & Generative AI Acumen: Solid understanding of Google Cloud’s AI capabilities (Vertex AI, Model Garden, Gemini API), and how to position them to solve real-world business problems.
  • C-Level Communication & Storytelling: Outstanding communication, presentation, and negotiation skills, with the ability to build trust and influence decision-makers at the executive level.
  • Commercial Strategy: Ability to structure complex deals, build business cases focused on ROI, and understand consumption-based cloud business models.
  • Data Strategy Knowledge: Strong understanding of modern data paradigms, such as Data Lakes, Data Governance, Data Mesh, and how data readiness impacts AI success.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Google Cloud Certifications: Google Cloud Professional Data Engineer, Cloud Architect, or Digital Leader certifications are a strong differentiator.
  • Partner Ecosystem Experience: Prior experience working within the Google Cloud partner ecosystem or directly at Google.
  • Technical Background: Previous hands-on experience as a Data Engineer, Data Architect, or Data Scientist is a plus, ensuring high technical credibility with clients' engineering teams.


Work Environment:

  • A fast-paced, high-growth environment focused on innovation and results.
  • High visibility, working directly with strategic clients and global tech leaders (Google).
  • Direct impact on the company’s revenue growth and strategic partnership status.


A Avenue Code reforça seu compromisso com a privacidade e com todos os princípios assegurados pelas legislações de proteção de dados mais rigorosas do mundo, como a GDPR, LGPD, CCPA e CPRA. Os dados dos(as) candidatos(as) compartilhados com a Avenue Code serão mantidos sob confidencialidade e não serão transmitidos a terceiros não envolvidos, nem utilizados para finalidades distintas do processo de candidatura às posições em aberto. title: Solutions Architect
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Solutions Architect em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

At Sisense, we help organizations turn complex data into actionable intelligence. As a Senior Solution Architect, you will play a critical role in designing, implementing, and optimizing enterprise-grade analytics deployments for customers with complex technical and business needs. You will partner closely with customers, internal stakeholders, and product teams to ensure successful outcomes across architecture, deployment, scalability, and long-term value realization.


Employment Type : Full-time position employed by a partner agency (3rd party, B2B)


WHY JOIN OUR SOLUTION ARCHITECT TEAM?

  • You will work at the intersection of customer success, cloud architecture, and data platforms.
  • You will help customers solve complex infrastructure, deployment, and performance challenges across Sisense environments.
  • You will collaborate with Product, R&D, Support, and Customer Success to shape best practices and improve the platform.
  • You will influence architecture decisions for strategic customers and high-visibility engagements.


IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL:

  • Lead custom multi-node Linux installations and upgrades for Sisense deployments, including troubleshooting complex deployment issues.
  • Own and troubleshoot multi-node Windows-to-Linux migration projects, backup and restore processes, and architecture-related escalations.
  • Perform load testing, interpret results, and provide strategic recommendations for scaling, performance, and resource optimization.
  • Analyze logs, system performance, and infrastructure telemetry to proactively identify risks and optimize customer environments.
  • Partner with customer Application Developers, DevOps, IT teams, and executive sponsors to drive successful outcomes.
  • Act as the voice of the customer by sharing product feedback, submitting bugs and feature requests, and influencing roadmap priorities.
  • Lead enablement for internal teams, mentor Solution Architects, and support technical interviews for new hires.


WHAT YOU’VE ACCOMPLISHED… SO FAR:

  • 5+ years of related experience in customer-facing technical roles, with prior experience as a Solution Architect.
  • Hands-on expertise with Linux (Ubuntu, Amazon Linux, RHEL/CentOS), Kubernetes, Docker, Helm, and cloud platforms such as AWS EKS / GKE.
  • Strong experience troubleshooting distributed systems, networking, security, and system monitoring tools such as Grafana and Coralogix.
  • Advanced working knowledge of MongoDB (or another NoSQL database), including query optimization and troubleshooting.
  • Intermediate SQL skills with the ability to join data across disparate sources and optimize queries.
  • Proficiency in scripting and coding with Bash, Python, JavaScript, and CSS.
  • Experience with load testing tools such as K6 and with modern cloud data warehouse technologies (Snowflake, Redshift, BigQuery) is a plus.
  • Strong customer communication skills, with the ability to engage technical teams and executive stakeholders.


HOW YOU’LL RAMP:

  • By Day 30: Build a strong understanding of Sisense architecture, deployment models, product capabilities, and customer engagement processes.
  • By Day 60: Independently lead standard and custom deployment activities, troubleshoot escalations, and support customer architecture reviews.
  • By Day 90: Own complex technical engagements end-to-end, mentor junior team members, and contribute to internal best practices and enablement.

title: Técnico de Eletrônica Sênior
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Técnico de Eletrônica Sênior em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Sobre a posição

A posição é essencial para garantir a execução de atividades técnicas relacionadas a manutenção de sistemas eletroeletrônicos, eletromecânicos, redes de telecomunicações (incluindo fibra óptica), além de suporte em automação industrial com CLPs e suas interfaces. O profissional também deverá atuar com instrumentos de medição, soldagem de componentes eletrônicos em placas de circuito impresso, elaboração de relatórios técnicos e ter domínio do pacote Office.

Responsabilidades:

  • Acompanhar a execução de serviços de manutenção preventiva e corretiva em sistemas eletroeletrônicos e eletromecânicos
  • Executar diagnósticos e intervenções em redes de telecomunicações, incluindo sistemas de fibra óptica (testes, fusão e certificação)
  • Atuar em sistemas de automação (CLPs e interfaces)
  • Elaborar relatórios técnicos e operar pacote Office
  • Eventualmente, realizar intervenções técnicas nos subsistemas dos trens (será fornecido suporte na execução das atividades)
  • Eventualmente, atuar em sistema de intercomunicação de elevadores (será fornecido suporte na execução das atividades)
  • Realizar o acompanhamento técnico de empresas terceiras durante a execução de projetos nos sistemas sob responsabilidade da área e elaborar relatórios diários de obra (fiscalização técnica, validação de entregas e interface com contratos)
  • Interagir com áreas internas e fornecedores para solução de problemas e melhoria contínua dos sistemas

Requisitos:

  • Formação técnica em eletrônica, eletrotécnica ou áreas correlatas
  • Conhecimentos em redes de telecomunicações, fibra óptica e automação
  • Experiência com instrumentos de medição
  • Experiência com solda de componentes eletrônicos
  • Boa capacidade de redação técnica e domínio do pacote Office
  • Experiência em gestão de projetos e/ou liderança de equipes multidisciplinares

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Banco de Talentos PCD | lojas adidas Salvador em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Objetivo e Relevância Global para a Organização:


Contribuir para o alcance das metas de KPI da loja, proporcionando uma experiência memorável para os consumidores e praticando os Valores da Marca, garantindo um ambiente inclusivo, colaborativo e acolhedor para todos os talentos.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

Principais Responsabilidades:


• Atuar no atendimento ao consumidor, oferecendo suporte e garantindo uma experiência de compra positiva e alinhada aos padrões de excelência da adidas.

• Apoiar as operações da loja de acordo com as necessidades do negócio, podendo atuar em diferentes frentes como atendimento, organização de produtos, estoque, caixa e suporte operacional.

• Contribuir para o alcance das metas individuais e coletivas da loja por meio de um atendimento de qualidade e foco na experiência do consumidor.

• Colaborar com a equipe em atividades operacionais e rotinas diárias da loja, garantindo organização, agilidade e eficiência nos processos.

• Cumprir todas as políticas e procedimentos da loja, contribuindo para um ambiente de trabalho seguro, respeitoso e inclusivo.

• Utilizar as ferramentas digitais e soluções omnichannel disponíveis para apoiar a jornada de compra do consumidor.

• Participar ativamente dos treinamentos e ações de desenvolvimento disponibilizados pela adidas.

• Demonstrar os 3 Cs da adidas (Confiança, Colaboração e Criatividade), fortalecendo a cultura da marca no dia a dia.

• Trabalhar em equipe, respeitando as individualidades e contribuindo para um ambiente acolhedor, diverso e inclusivo para todos.


Requisitos e qualificações

Habilidades e Conhecimentos:


• Boa comunicação e facilidade para trabalhar em equipe.

• Interesse em atuar com atendimento ao consumidor e rotinas de loja.

• Organização, responsabilidade e proatividade.

• Vontade de aprender e se desenvolver no ambiente de retail.

• Capacidade de adaptação às diferentes atividades e necessidades da operação.

• Afinidade com esporte, moda e cultura da marca será considerado um diferencial.


Experiência e Formação Exigidas / Qualificações Mínimas:


• Ensino médio completo ou cursando.

• Não é necessária experiência prévia, mas experiência com atendimento ao consumidor será considerada um diferencial.

• Vaga destinada a pessoas com deficiência (PCD).

title: Solutions Architect | Data & AI (Presales)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Solutions Architect | Data & AI (Presales) em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Avenue Code is the leading software consultancy focused on delivering end-to-end development solutions for digital transformation across every vertical. We’re privately held, profitable, and have been on a solid growth trajectory since day one. We care deeply about our clients, our partners, and our people. We prefer the word ‘partner’ over ‘vendor’, and our investment in professional relationships is a reflection of that philosophy. We pride ourselves on our technical acumen, our collaborative problem-solving ability, and the warm professionalism of our teams.


About the Opportunity:

As a Solutions Architect specialized in Data & AI, you will be responsible for driving business growth, expanding our market share, and accelerating our strategic partnership with Google Cloud.


This is a highly strategic, technical-commercial role. You will act as the trusted advisor for our clients, identifying new business opportunities, understanding complex business challenges, and architecting customized Google Cloud Data & AI solutions. Your ultimate goal is to bridge the gap between technical excellence and business value, presenting high-impact pitches to C-level executives to close deals and maximize Google Cloud adoption.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Business Development & Pipeline Growth: Identify, qualify, and develop new business opportunities for Data and Generative AI solutions within our Google Cloud ecosystem.
  • Google Partnership Alignment: Work closely with Google Cloud’s internal sales and technical teams (Partner Managers, Account Executives, and CE/CEs) to co-sell, align strategies, and map target accounts.
  • Executive Pitching & Value Selling: Lead discovery sessions and deliver compelling technical-commercial pitches to C-Level executives (CDO, CIO, CTO, CMO), translating complex technical architectures into clear business outcomes, ROI, and strategic value.
  • Solution Architecture & Prototyping: Design high-level, customized data architectures and coordinate rapid Proof of Concepts (PoCs) on Google Cloud to validate value and accelerate the client’s buying decision.
  • Proposal & RFP Leadership: Own the technical-commercial strategy for complex proposals and RFPs, defining the scope, commercial engineering, and value proposition of the proposed Google Cloud solution.
  • Advanced English


Required Qualifications:

  • Proven BDM or Technical Pre-Sales Experience: Solid track record in Business Development, Technical Sales, or Solution Architecture within the IT/Cloud Consulting industry, specifically driving cloud revenue.
  • Google Cloud Ecosystem Expertise: Deep knowledge of Google Cloud's data portfolio (BigQuery, Cloud Composer, Dataproc, Pub/Sub, Dataflow).
  • AI & Generative AI Acumen: Solid understanding of Google Cloud’s AI capabilities (Vertex AI, Model Garden, Gemini API), and how to position them to solve real-world business problems.
  • C-Level Communication & Storytelling: Outstanding communication, presentation, and negotiation skills, with the ability to build trust and influence decision-makers at the executive level.
  • Commercial Strategy: Ability to structure complex deals, build business cases focused on ROI, and understand consumption-based cloud business models.
  • Data Strategy Knowledge: Strong understanding of modern data paradigms, such as Data Lakes, Data Governance, Data Mesh, and how data readiness impacts AI success.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Google Cloud Certifications: Google Cloud Professional Data Engineer, Cloud Architect, or Digital Leader certifications are a strong differentiator.
  • Partner Ecosystem Experience: Prior experience working within the Google Cloud partner ecosystem or directly at Google.
  • Technical Background: Previous hands-on experience as a Data Engineer, Data Architect, or Data Scientist is a plus, ensuring high technical credibility with clients' engineering teams.


Work Environment:

  • A fast-paced, high-growth environment focused on innovation and results.
  • High visibility, working directly with strategic clients and global tech leaders (Google).
  • Direct impact on the company’s revenue growth and strategic partnership status.


A Avenue Code reforça seu compromisso com a privacidade e com todos os princípios assegurados pelas legislações de proteção de dados mais rigorosas do mundo, como a GDPR, LGPD, CCPA e CPRA. Os dados dos(as) candidatos(as) compartilhados com a Avenue Code serão mantidos sob confidencialidade e não serão transmitidos a terceiros não envolvidos, nem utilizados para finalidades distintas do processo de candidatura às posições em aberto. Por se tratar de uma empresa de consultoria, a Avenue Code poderá compartilhar suas informações com seus clientes e com outras empresas do Grupo CompassUol, às quais os(as) consultores(as) da Avenue Code estejam alocados para a prestação de serviços.

title: Remote Chemistry Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Remote Chemistry Specialist em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Turing: Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


Role Overview:

The Chemical Reasoning & Discovery Engineer is responsible for creating high-quality reasoning datasets that evaluate and improve the scientific reasoning capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs). This role focuses on designing chemistry-centered discovery tasks that require models to analyze experimental or simulated data, identify chemical relationships, infer reaction rules and molecular behaviors, estimate parameters, and predict outcomes under varying conditions. The ideal candidate combines strong expertise in chemistry, quantitative analysis, and scientific methodology to develop rigorous, reproducible, and logically consistent evaluation tasks.


What does day-to-day look like

  • Designed chemistry-based reasoning scenarios using experimental results, molecular data, and simulated chemical systems.
  • Authored multi-step tasks involving reaction analysis, chemical property inference, parameter estimation, and predictive reasoning.
  • Developed evaluation problems focused on pattern discovery, reaction mechanisms, model selection, and scientific consistency checks.
  • Created deterministic solutions, reference explanations, and detailed scoring rubrics for model assessment.
  • Collaborated with reviewers and LLM engineers to ensure scientific accuracy, clarity, and reproducibility across datasets.


Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated 3+ years of experience in chemistry, chemical research, scientific computing, laboratory analysis, or related analytical fields.
  • Applied strong knowledge of chemical principles, scientific reasoning, quantitative modeling, and data interpretation.
  • Utilized expertise in experimental design, reaction mechanisms, stoichiometry, thermodynamics, kinetics, or simulation-based analysis.
  • Communicated complex chemical concepts, assumptions, and findings through clear and structured documentation.
  • Evaluated scientific reasoning with exceptional attention to detail, logical consistency, and reproducible outcomes.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required : 4 hours of overlap with PST.
  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of contract : 8 weeks.

title: AI Curriculum Designer & Developer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para AI Curriculum Designer & Developer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

AI Curriculum Designer & Developer


Role Details

Position: AI Curriculum Designer & Developer

Commitment: Full-Time (40 Hours/Week)

Location: Remote

Work Schedule: Overlap with U.S. business hours preferred


About Us

Talent Global connects high-performing remote professionals with fast-growing international companies. We focus on long-term partnerships, cultural alignment, and helping exceptional talent thrive in impactful roles.


Role Overview

We are looking for an AI Curriculum Designer & Developer to join a fast-growing education-focused organization creating engaging learning experiences for K-12 students.

This is a highly AI-driven curriculum development role that combines educational expertise, creativity, project leadership, and technology. The ideal candidate has experience designing curriculum, lessons, educational content, or learning experiences for children and is passionate about leveraging AI to improve how educational content is created, refined, and delivered.

The successful candidate will lead curriculum development projects, collaborate with cross-functional teams, and actively incorporate advanced AI tools and workflows into the content creation process. We are looking for someone who embraces innovation, enjoys experimenting with new technologies, and views AI as a core part of their daily workflow rather than simply a supporting tool.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design and develop engaging curriculum, lessons, educational content, and learning experiences for K-12 learners
  • Create learning objectives, instructional materials, assessments, and supporting educational resources
  • Apply storytelling, age-appropriate learning strategies, and student engagement principles to curriculum development
  • Lead curriculum and content development projects from planning through final delivery
  • Collaborate with curriculum, content, product, design, and technical teams
  • Leverage AI tools and workflows to improve content quality, efficiency, scalability, and personalization
  • Evaluate and adopt emerging AI technologies relevant to curriculum design and educational content creation
  • Help optimize and refine AI-assisted curriculum development processes
  • Ensure educational content meets high standards of quality, accuracy, clarity, and learner engagement
  • Manage timelines, priorities, and deliverables across multiple projects


Must-Have Requirements

  • Fluent English speaker with excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • 3+ years of experience in curriculum design, instructional design, education, learning experience design, or educational content development
  • Experience developing curriculum, lessons, or educational materials for K-12 learners
  • Experience leading curriculum, instructional design, or educational content projects
  • Strong understanding of learning science, instructional design principles, and child-centered education
  • Demonstrated experience incorporating AI into curriculum development or content creation workflows
  • Experience using AI tools beyond basic prompting and content generation
  • Strong project management, organization, and stakeholder communication skills
  • Comfortable working independently in a remote environment
  • Strong curiosity for emerging technologies and AI-driven innovation


Nice-to-Have Requirements

  • Experience in EdTech, curriculum publishing, or digital learning environments
  • Experience developing educational books, workbooks, lesson plans, or classroom resources
  • Experience creating social-emotional learning (SEL) or character development content
  • Experience working with AI-powered content generation systems, agents, or automated workflows
  • Experience collaborating with engineering, product, or technical teams
  • Experience building scalable educational content production systems


Ideal Candidate

  • Passionate about education and creating meaningful learning experiences for children
  • Highly AI-driven and actively explores new technologies and workflows
  • Comfortable working in fast-paced, innovation-focused environments
  • Strong balance of creativity, educational expertise, and operational execution
  • Excited to lead projects and drive continuous improvement in curriculum development processes
  • Sees AI as a core component of modern educational content creation

Oportunidade de atuação em projeto — Arquiteto de Soluções de Dados


Sobre a DataEX:

Com 12 anos de atuação no mercado, a DataEX é uma consultoria especializada em Dados e IA, com parcerias estratégicas com Microsoft, AWS e Databricks, atuando em projetos de alto impacto para grandes clientes. Valorizamos a inovação, a colaboração, o desenvolvimento contínuo e a qualidade de vida, com incentivos para certificações e bem-estar.


Contexto do projeto:

  • Estamos com uma oportunidade para atuação em projeto estratégico na área de Dados, em um de nossos principais clientes, com foco na definição e evolução da arquitetura corporativa de dados. Buscamos um profissional com perfil consultivo, visão estratégica e sólida experiência em ambientes modernos de dados e analytics, para atuar na concepção de soluções escaláveis e de missão crítica.


Perfil Técnico Esperado:

  • Experiência em arquitetura Big Data utilizando Databricks (Lakehouse, Unity Catalog)
  • Experiência com ambientes Azure e Microsoft Fabric (Data Factory, Synapse Analytics e Microsoft Fabric).
  • Engenharia e Processamento Distribuído: Experiência em linguagem de programação Python, SQL e PySpark, com entendimento arquitetura destruída Spark.
  • Arquitetura e Estimativa: Proficiência no desenho de arquiteturas de dados escaláveis e estimativas de esforço desenvolvimento e custos Nuvem (calculadora do Azure), projetar custos de infraestrutura e otimizar workloads.
  • Background em BI Tradicional (Microsoft Stack): Experiência consolidada com SQL Server, SSIS e SSAS para compreender sistemas legados, garantindo integrações ou migrações seguras para a nuvem.
  • Visualização de Dados: Conhecimento da arquitetura e modelagem de dados para desenho de sugestão de dados integradas
  • Modelagem e Bancos de Dados: Fluência no trânsito entre ambientes relacionais e não-relacionais (NoSQL), garantindo o modelo adequado para cada caso de uso.
  • Metodologias Ágeis: Conhecimento dos ritos de agilidade (Scrum ou Kanban), com mensuração, alimentação (storytelling) de histórias de usuário e tarefas atribuídas as suas atividades


Escopo de Atuação

  • Conduzir workshops de discovery e levantamento de requisitos junto às áreas de negócio, compreendendo desafios, necessidades e oportunidades relacionadas a dados e analytics.
  • Traduzir requisitos funcionais e não funcionais em arquiteturas de dados modernas, escaláveis e alinhadas às necessidades do negócio.
  • Elaborar arquiteturas de referência, diagramas técnicos e propostas de solução para projetos de dados, analytics e inteligência artificial.
  • Definir estratégias de ingestão, armazenamento, processamento e consumo de dados utilizando Data Lake, Data Warehouse e arquiteturas Lakehouse.
  • Realizar modelagem de dados conceitual, lógica e física para suportar diferentes cenários analíticos e operacionais.
  • Definir e revisar estratégias de integração de dados entre sistemas corporativos, aplicações legadas e plataformas em nuvem.
  • Realizar estimativas de esforço, sizing técnico, cronogramas e dimensionamento de equipes para iniciativas de dados.
  • Elaborar estimativas e projeções de custos de infraestrutura em nuvem Azure, identificando oportunidades de otimização financeira e tecnológica.
  • Apoiar a definição de padrões arquiteturais relacionados à segurança, governança, qualidade e acesso aos dados.
  • Avaliar novas tecnologias e soluções do mercado, recomendando sua adoção quando houver ganhos reais de eficiência, escalabilidade ou redução de custos.
  • Atuar como referência técnica para equipes de Engenharia de Dados, Analytics, BI e Desenvolvimento.
  • Conduzir apresentações técnicas e executivas para stakeholders, traduzindo conceitos complexos em benefícios de negócio.

title: MES Business Analyst(Aveva)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para MES Business Analyst(Aveva) em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Job Summary:

  • Our client is looking for a MES Global Business Analyst. Needs to have senior level MES skills, with at least 1 Aveva project. Focus is more from the business side but needs to be able to interact with the technical team and will need some hands on Aveva experience.
  • This role supports a large-scale MES program across 26 sites, acting as a global business system owner with strong functional accountability for harmonizing manufacturing processes, shaping MES capabilities, and ensuring business alignment across implementations.


Responsibilities

  • Collect user requirements from sites and drive standardization and harmonization of MES-supported manufacturing processes
  • Support the definition of core MES data structures such as Master batch records, materials, resources, and master data
  • Review functional solution design proposed by the system integrator and escalate gaps, risks, or misalignment with business needs
  • Monitor and control solution definition across multiple parallel implementations to ensure consistency of core MES functions
  • Oversee UAT preparation and execution, ensuring test scenarios adequately cover critical manufacturing and compliance processes
  • Assess change impacts at site level, including process adoption, training needs, and local operational readiness
  • Production of project status reports and functional progress updates for MES deployments
  • Escalation management for process, design, and deployment issues affecting MES implementation
  • Coordination of cross-functional teams involved in MES design, testing, and rollout
  • Support global business activities related to manufacturing execution, electronic batch records, and process standardization
  • Support the global business application owner in functional maintenance, enhancement prioritization, and solution testing and governance


Required Qualifications

  • At least 5-7 years of experience in OT/IT projects within manufacturing, including significant exposure to MES implementation as a business representative or functional lead
  • Strong functional understanding of MES capabilities such as electronic batch records, recipe/workflow execution, material traceability, review by exception, and equipment status management
  • Experience translating site business needs into user requirements, process flows, and harmonized global solutions
  • Experience in GxP-regulated environments, ideally within pharmaceutical manufacturing
  • Good knowledge of pharma manufacturing processes, including batch execution, dispensing, weighing, and quality-related process controls
  • Experience working in Agile or hybrid project delivery models is preferred
  • Experience in MES implementation projects within regulated manufacturing environments, ideally in Pharma
  • Functional exposure to MES-related capabilities such as eBR, batch execution, material genealogy, deviation handling, review by exception, and integration with ERP/LIMS/warehouse systems
  • Experience with GxP documentation, validation support, and controlled deployment of digital manufacturing solutions
  • Ability to quickly understand and adopt new MES platforms and technologies


Musts:

  • Minimum of 5-7 years MES experience
  • At least 1 project on Aveva MES
  • Business Analyst experience, with enough technical expertise to interface with the technical team
  • Integration with SAP
  • Integration with the L2 layer (Scada, PLCs etc), so they can understand process flows
  • Experience with eBR, batch execution
  • UAT experience
  • Latin America based


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with other MES solutions would be nice to have, not essential
  • Brazil based

title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer, AI-Native
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Full-Stack Engineer, AI-Native em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Zaigo builds AI software for real businesses.
Not demos. Not slide decks. Actual tools that people use to run parts of their company.
Our clients are usually owner-led or mid-market companies in the US: professional services firms, distributors, manufacturers, healthcare operators, finance teams. They have messy workflows, old systems, weird data, and very little patience for theory. We figure out what should exist, then we build it.
We are looking for a senior full-stack engineer who already builds heavily with AI. Someone who can take a vague client problem, turn it into a product plan, build the thing, polish it, ship it, and keep moving.
If you need perfect specs, this probably is not the job. If you like owning the whole problem and moving faster than normal teams think is reasonable, it might be.
What the work looks like
You will own client projects end to end.
That means you may be on a call with a business owner in the morning, designing the workflow after lunch, and shipping the first usable version that week. The work is full-stack product engineering: database, backend, UI, auth, integrations, AI agents, evals, error handling, deployment, and the judgment to know what should not be handled by a model.
Recent Zaigo-style projects include:
a document review tool that checks presentations against a firm's brand and compliance rules
a benchmarking platform built from years of public company filings
payroll and operations tools that clean messy data and produce files people can actually use
internal AI agents that help teams move faster without giving the model dangerous autonomy
You do not need to be an ML researcher. You do need to be a very strong engineer who knows how to use AI tools to ship better and faster.
Who we are looking for
You are probably a fit if this sounds like you:
You have 5+ years building software professionally.
You can ship across the stack: frontend, backend, database, integrations, deployment.
You use AI coding tools every day, not as a novelty. Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, agents, worktrees, parallel terminals, your own setup. We care less about the exact tools and more about whether you have real opinions from using them.
You think like a product owner. You ask what the user is trying to do, what the first useful version should be, and what will make people trust the system.
You can work with ambiguity. Clients rarely hand you perfect requirements.
You have taste. There is no reason to ship ugly software anymore.
You communicate clearly in English and can talk through tradeoffs with US clients.
You have high initiative. You fix things nobody assigned. You build outside work because you like building.
Bonus points if you have founded something, freelanced, run a small agency, built your own product, or worked directly with clients.
Who should not apply
This is probably not the right role if you want a narrow lane, a long roadmap, and fully written tickets.
It is also probably not right if your AI experience is mostly prompting ChatGPT, building toy demos, or talking about agents without shipping production software.
We need builders. Smart, fast, practical builders.
Process
Short application.
10-minute async voice interview.
Live interview with Zaigo's founder.
Short practical build project.
Offer if it is a fit.
We move quickly. If there is a fit, you will hear from us within days, not weeks.

title: Customer Service Representative
description:
