Instead of applying to one remote job, you could access a community where new remote opportunities become available every week.


At Virtual Latinos, we connect experienced professionals from Latin America with growing companies in the U.S., Canada, and beyond that are building distributed remote teams. Our community includes more than 5,000+ professionals hired and 2,500+ companies that rely on Virtual Latinos to find skilled remote talent.


Join a community where you'll learn, connect with like-minded professionals, and access real remote opportunities with top North American companies.


Highlight Role of the Week!


Customer Service Specialist (Remote)


About the role:


This opportunity is designed for experienced customer service professionals who are comfortable managing multi-channel support operations, resolving complex inquiries, handling escalations, and delivering high-quality customer experiences in fast-paced remote environments.


Pay Rates:


Part-Time Monthly Rates : $840-$$1,400 (based on 20 hours per week schedule)


Full-Time Monthly Rates : $1,680-$2,800 (based on 40 hours per week schedule)


The posted monthly salary range is an average monthly income. However, all jobs at Virtual Latinos are hourly, and pay is calculated based on the number of hours worked daily. We pay our Virtual Professionals every 2 weeks through third-party platforms. The hourly rate range of the position is $10.50 - $17.50, depending on experience. Once a rate has been offered to you, it is non-negotiable.


Work Schedule:


The work schedule will vary depending on the position and client. Most schedules align with U.S. and Canadian business hours.


Key responsibilities:


  • Multi-Channel Customer Support: Handle customer inquiries across phone, email, live chat, and social media, ensuring timely, professional, and solution-oriented responses.
  • Escalation & Problem Resolution: Diagnose complex customer issues, troubleshoot effectively, and manage escalations through resolution while maintaining customer satisfaction and retention.
  • Account Management & CRM Administration: Update and maintain accurate customer records, process account changes, and ensure data integrity within CRM and helpdesk systems (Zendesk, Freshdesk, HubSpot, Intercom, or similar).
  • Product & Service Expertise: Maintain deep knowledge of products, services, and internal processes to provide accurate guidance and proactive recommendations to customers.
  • Reporting & Process Improvement: Document customer interactions, identify recurring issues and trends, and provide actionable feedback to support teams and leadership to improve service quality.


Depending on the client, you may also support order processing, returns management, knowledge base maintenance, or quality assurance initiatives.


What you bring:


  • Must be 21+ years old
  • 1+ years of experience in customer service, customer support, or client-facing roles
  • Bilingual English (C1 or above) / Spanish


Required Skills:


  • Strong understanding of customer service best practices, support workflows, and escalation procedures
  • Experience working with CRM or helpdesk platforms (Zendesk, Freshdesk, HubSpot, Intercom, Salesforce Service Cloud, LiveAgent, Zoho Desk, or similar)
  • Familiarity with communication and collaboration tools (Slack, Microsoft Teams, Dialpad, RingCentral, Aircall, or similar)
  • Experience with ticketing and knowledge base systems (Jira Service Management, Help Scout, Confluence, Notion, or similar)
  • Proficiency in productivity and scheduling tools (Google Workspace, Microsoft Office 365, Calendly, or similar)

title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer, AI-Native
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Full-Stack Engineer, AI-Native em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Zaigo builds AI software for real businesses.
Not demos. Not slide decks. Actual tools that people use to run parts of their company.
Our clients are usually owner-led or mid-market companies in the US: professional services firms, distributors, manufacturers, healthcare operators, finance teams. They have messy workflows, old systems, weird data, and very little patience for theory. We figure out what should exist, then we build it.
We are looking for a senior full-stack engineer who already builds heavily with AI. Someone who can take a vague client problem, turn it into a product plan, build the thing, polish it, ship it, and keep moving.
If you need perfect specs, this probably is not the job. If you like owning the whole problem and moving faster than normal teams think is reasonable, it might be.
What the work looks like
You will own client projects end to end.
That means you may be on a call with a business owner in the morning, designing the workflow after lunch, and shipping the first usable version that week. The work is full-stack product engineering: database, backend, UI, auth, integrations, AI agents, evals, error handling, deployment, and the judgment to know what should not be handled by a model.
Recent Zaigo-style projects include:
a document review tool that checks presentations against a firm's brand and compliance rules
a benchmarking platform built from years of public company filings
payroll and operations tools that clean messy data and produce files people can actually use
internal AI agents that help teams move faster without giving the model dangerous autonomy
You do not need to be an ML researcher. You do need to be a very strong engineer who knows how to use AI tools to ship better and faster.
Who we are looking for
You are probably a fit if this sounds like you:
You have 5+ years building software professionally.
You can ship across the stack: frontend, backend, database, integrations, deployment.
You use AI coding tools every day, not as a novelty. Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, agents, worktrees, parallel terminals, your own setup. We care less about the exact tools and more about whether you have real opinions from using them.
You think like a product owner. You ask what the user is trying to do, what the first useful version should be, and what will make people trust the system.
You can work with ambiguity. Clients rarely hand you perfect requirements.
You have taste. There is no reason to ship ugly software anymore.
You communicate clearly in English and can talk through tradeoffs with US clients.
You have high initiative. You fix things nobody assigned. You build outside work because you like building.
Bonus points if you have founded something, freelanced, run a small agency, built your own product, or worked directly with clients.
Who should not apply
This is probably not the right role if you want a narrow lane, a long roadmap, and fully written tickets.
It is also probably not right if your AI experience is mostly prompting ChatGPT, building toy demos, or talking about agents without shipping production software.
We need builders. Smart, fast, practical builders.
Process
Short application.
10-minute async voice interview.
Live interview with Zaigo's founder.
Short practical build project.
Offer if it is a fit.
We move quickly. If there is a fit, you will hear from us within days, not weeks.

title: Senior Warehouse Automation Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Warehouse Automation Specialist em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Location: Brazil/Remote

Contract: Permanent / Freelance

Experience Level: Senior

Language: English and Portuguese



Mission Overview

We are looking for a Senior Warehouse Automation Specialist to lead the design, implementation, and optimization of advanced automation solutions within distribution and logistics environments.

You will act as a key System Engineer , bridging operational needs with cutting-edge technologies such as robotics, RTLS (Real-Time Locating Systems), and machine vision systems to drive efficiency, accuracy, and scalability.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in complex environments and enjoys combining technical expertise, data analysis, and project leadership to transform warehouse operations.


Key Responsibilities

System Design & Implementation

  • Design and deploy automated warehouse systems (AS/RS, conveyors, AGVs, robotic picking solutions)
  • Integrate RTLS solutions for real-time tracking of assets and inventory
  • Lead end-to-end system architecture aligned with operational requirements

Technical Optimization & Performance

  • Analyze workflows and system performance to identify bottlenecks
  • Implement data-driven improvements to maximize throughput and efficiency
  • Optimize warehouse execution systems (WES), warehouse management systems (WMS), and automation tools

Maintenance & Troubleshooting

  • Monitor and ensure high availability of automation systems (robotics, sensors, vision systems)
  • Diagnose and resolve system issues across hardware and software layers
  • Maintain system documentation and continuous improvement processes

Project Management & Delivery

  • Lead or contribute to automation projects from concept to deployment
  • Coordinate with cross-functional teams (operations, IT, engineering)
  • Ensure minimal disruption to live operations during implementation

Training & Change Management

  • Support operational teams in adopting new technologies
  • Provide training and documentation for system usage and best practices

Safety & Compliance

  • Ensure all systems comply with safety standards and industry regulations
  • Contribute to improving workplace safety and ergonomics


Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience in warehouse automation, system engineering, or industrial automation
  • Proven experience with RTLS (Real-Time Locating Systems)
  • Strong background in machine vision systems
  • Hands-on experience with:
  • WMS / WES systems
  • Robotics, AGVs, or automated material handling systems
  • Solid understanding of electro-mechanical systems, sensors, and control systems
  • Willingness and ability to travel regularly (nationally and/or internationally) to support project deployments and client sites


Nice to Have

  • Experience in project management (PMP or equivalent is a plus)
  • Knowledge of programming/scripting (Python or similar)
  • Experience with data analysis and performance optimization
  • Background in industrial engineering, robotics, or logistics systems
  • Portuguese knowledge


Key Skills

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities
  • System-level thinking and architecture mindset
  • Ability to work in complex, fast-paced environments
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills

title: MES Business Analyst(Aveva)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para MES Business Analyst(Aveva) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Job Summary:

  • Our client is looking for a MES Global Business Analyst. Needs to have senior level MES skills, with at least 1 Aveva project. Focus is more from the business side but needs to be able to interact with the technical team and will need some hands on Aveva experience.
  • This role supports a large-scale MES program across 26 sites, acting as a global business system owner with strong functional accountability for harmonizing manufacturing processes, shaping MES capabilities, and ensuring business alignment across implementations.


Responsibilities

  • Collect user requirements from sites and drive standardization and harmonization of MES-supported manufacturing processes
  • Support the definition of core MES data structures such as Master batch records, materials, resources, and master data
  • Review functional solution design proposed by the system integrator and escalate gaps, risks, or misalignment with business needs
  • Monitor and control solution definition across multiple parallel implementations to ensure consistency of core MES functions
  • Oversee UAT preparation and execution, ensuring test scenarios adequately cover critical manufacturing and compliance processes
  • Assess change impacts at site level, including process adoption, training needs, and local operational readiness
  • Production of project status reports and functional progress updates for MES deployments
  • Escalation management for process, design, and deployment issues affecting MES implementation
  • Coordination of cross-functional teams involved in MES design, testing, and rollout
  • Support global business activities related to manufacturing execution, electronic batch records, and process standardization
  • Support the global business application owner in functional maintenance, enhancement prioritization, and solution testing and governance


Required Qualifications

  • At least 5-7 years of experience in OT/IT projects within manufacturing, including significant exposure to MES implementation as a business representative or functional lead
  • Strong functional understanding of MES capabilities such as electronic batch records, recipe/workflow execution, material traceability, review by exception, and equipment status management
  • Experience translating site business needs into user requirements, process flows, and harmonized global solutions
  • Experience in GxP-regulated environments, ideally within pharmaceutical manufacturing
  • Good knowledge of pharma manufacturing processes, including batch execution, dispensing, weighing, and quality-related process controls
  • Experience working in Agile or hybrid project delivery models is preferred
  • Experience in MES implementation projects within regulated manufacturing environments, ideally in Pharma
  • Functional exposure to MES-related capabilities such as eBR, batch execution, material genealogy, deviation handling, review by exception, and integration with ERP/LIMS/warehouse systems
  • Experience with GxP documentation, validation support, and controlled deployment of digital manufacturing solutions
  • Ability to quickly understand and adopt new MES platforms and technologies


Musts:

  • Minimum of 5-7 years MES experience
  • At least 1 project on Aveva MES
  • Business Analyst experience, with enough technical expertise to interface with the technical team
  • Integration with SAP
  • Integration with the L2 layer (Scada, PLCs etc), so they can understand process flows
  • Experience with eBR, batch execution
  • UAT experience
  • Latin America based


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with other MES solutions would be nice to have, not essential
  • Brazil based

  • Gestão de projetos de equipamentos comerciais
  • Vendas técnicas B2B
  • Equipamentos de HVAC ou ar-condicionado comercial
  • Lavanderia comercial

Capacidade de compreender requisitos de clientes, especificações técnicas, seleção de produtos, cenários de aplicação, acompanhamento de RFQ e comunicação de projetos.

Boas habilidades de comunicação e capacidade de trabalhar com clientes, fornecedores, instaladores, distribuidores, consultores e equipes de procurement no Brasil.

Domínio do português. A capacidade de se comunicar em inglês será considerada uma vantagem.

Preferido

  • Experiência com projetos de hotéis, restaurantes, supermercados, lavanderias, hospitais, escolas ou edifícios comerciais
  • Experiência com HVAC comercial, lavanderia comercial, cozinha comercial, refrigeração, iluminação ou displays comerciais
  • Conhecimento de instalação, manutenção, seleção técnica ou operação de equipamentos comerciais
  • Experiência em acompanhamento de RFQ, coordenação de cotações, suporte a projetos ou desenvolvimento de oportunidades comerciais
  • Recursos de clientes, instaladores, distribuidores ou fornecedores no Brasil

Este cargo é focado no acompanhamento de projetos e desenvolvimento de negócios no mercado brasileiro.

As principais áreas de trabalho incluem:

  • Comunicação com clientes

title: Business Analyst
description:

Job Responsibilities:

Job Title: Global Trade Compliance Business Analyst

Introduction: We are seeking an experienced Global Trade Compliance Business Analyst to join our team and play a critical role in supporting the business across a broad spectrum of global import and export compliance matters. This position is vital in ensuring our compliance with international trade regulations while enabling data-driven decision-making through the creation of innovative dashboards and reports. The successful candidate will leverage their expertise in global trade compliance and advanced analytics tools to model the potential impact of tariffs on the business model and drive continuous improvement in compliance processes.

Roles and Responsibilities:

  • Collaborate with regional trade compliance teams and business stakeholders to gather, document, and refine business requirements and functional processes, adapting them as business needs evolve.
  • Maintain and oversee day-to-day global classification processes to support global import volumes, ensuring accuracy and compliance.
  • Assist with technology, hardware, and software trade classification, including management of Harmonized Tariff Schedule (HTS) , Schedule B , and Export Control Classification Number (ECCN) classifications.
  • Manage compliance activities equally focused on imports and exports (50% each).
  • Develop and contribute to documented classification justifications based on the General Rules of Interpretation (GRI) foundation for global import classifications.
  • Provide import compliance guidance in adherence to US and international regulations, including conducting research, updating status reports, and coordinating deliverables within the team.
  • Build, maintain, and analyze data-informed metrics to generate actionable insights that enhance the global trade compliance program.
  • Establish and nurture positive business relationships with key stakeholders and cross-functional teams.
  • Engage with software development teams to understand and influence evolving compliance technology, identifying opportunities to automate manual processes.
  • Generate and contribute to performance requirements, timelines, and metrics for all related activities.
  • Support project management efforts to ensure timely delivery of team assignments and objectives.


Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain, Logistics, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience as a Business Analyst, preferably within supply chain, logistics, or global trade compliance environments.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to produce clear documentation including Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and detailed reports.
  • Proven experience with global trade compliance regulations, including import/export laws and logistics preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently research and dive deep into complex compliance requests and issues.


Tools and Technologies:

  • Proficient in Smartsheet , Power BI , and AWS Quicksight with hands-on experience creating new dashboards, running data batches, and developing meaningful metrics and reports.
  • Strong data analytics and data entry skills to support compliance reporting and insights generation.
  • Familiarity with trade classification tools and regulatory databases is a plus.


Skills:

Global trade compliance, Smartsheet, Power BI, AWS Quicksight

Estamos procurando um Gerente de Projetos – Equipamentos Comerciais, Brasil para apoiar o desenvolvimento e acompanhamento de projetos da SolutionMall no mercado brasileiro.

Esta função é adequada para profissionais com experiência em gestão de projetos, vendas técnicas, desenvolvimento de negócios, equipamentos comerciais, HVAC, lavanderia comercial, cozinha comercial, hotelaria, supermercados, facilities, instalação de equipamentos ou projetos B2B.

O foco principal é entender as necessidades dos clientes, acompanhar oportunidades de projetos, coordenar RFQs e cotações, apoiar a seleção de equipamentos comerciais e ajudar no avanço de projetos com clientes, fornecedores, instaladores e partes interessadas.

Este é um cargo voltado para projetos B2B, com foco em equipamentos comerciais, seleção técnica, coordenação de fornecedores, comunicação com clientes e desenvolvimento de projetos no Brasil.


3. Principais responsabilidades

Boas habilidades de comunicação e capacidade de trabalhar com clientes, fornecedores, instaladores, distribuidores, consultores e equipes de procurement no Brasil.

Domínio do português. A capacidade de se comunicar em inglês será considerada uma vantagem.

Preferido

  • Experiência com HVAC comercial, lavanderia comercial, cozinha comercial, refrigeração, iluminação ou displays comerciais
  • Conhecimento de instalação, manutenção, seleção técnica ou operação de equipamentos comerciais

title: Lead Product Designer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Lead Product Designer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Who are we?

Transcenda, headquartered in the US, was founded in July 2019 and is a full-lifecycle product development company. With locations throughout Romania, Poland, Ukraine, and Brazil, Transcenda works with Fortune 500 companies and well-funded startups to help bring new products to life.


Transcenda helps companies ideate new product concepts, build prototypes, design world-class solutions then engineer new commercial products. Transcenda puts people first and strives to be a changemaker by building a better world through technology. Transcenda has grown from a 5-person team to over 250 people over the past four years and plans to continue growing.


About the role

This is a senior, consultancy-style design role. You'll move between leading projects end-to-end — driving discovery, aligning stakeholders, shaping direction — and rolling up your sleeves as a senior-level individual contributor when that's what the work needs.


You'll be working on mature, live products where the bar is improving what exists: smoothing workflows, sharpening hierarchy, lifting conversion, and removing friction. This is not a greenfield, portfolio-piece role. If you get satisfaction from making a working product noticeably better for the people who use it every day, you'll like it here.



Key responsibilities

  • Take ownership of design problems on assigned projects — frame the problem, drive it through discovery, design, and delivery, and bring stakeholders along the whole way.
  • Lead or contribute on a project depending on what's needed — sometimes you're directing the design effort, sometimes you're the one in Figma producing the work. Both modes should feel comfortable.
  • Partner closely with product managers and engineers, translating ambiguous requirements into concrete, testable design solutions and iterating against live implementations.
  • Run the iterative cycle from low-fidelity exploration through high-fidelity delivery, with usability validation at the points where it actually changes the outcome.
  • Facilitate workshops, design reviews, and working sessions with cross-functional and executive stakeholders. Make decisions visible and trade-offs explicit.
  • Mentor and raise the bar for designers around you.
  • Build durable relationships with stakeholders. Understand what they're actually trying to achieve and push back constructively when the brief is wrong.


Must haves

  • 6–10+ years of UX/Product Design experience, ideally including time in a consultancy, agency, or embedded-team setting where you've owned client or stakeholder relationships directly.
  • Demonstrated ability to flex between leading a project (or a small team) and contributing as a senior IC, depending on what the engagement needs.
  • Track record of improving existing products rather than designing greenfield experiences — measurable wins on usability, conversion, or workflow efficiency.
  • Strong visual and UI judgment for forms, workflows, CTAs, hierarchy, and layout. You can defend a layout decision on the merits.
  • Comfort working closely with engineering against live implementations — you can read a real interface and tell us what's wrong with it before opening Figma.
  • Ability to articulate why a design decision was made and what problem it solves, to audiences ranging from engineers to executives.
  • Experience facilitating cross-functional workshops and leading business reviews or strategic planning sessions with senior stakeholders.


Nice to have

  • Background designing for regulated or enterprise domains (finance, compliance, GRC, banking, or similar).
  • Experience designing software embedded inside third-party platforms.
  • Familiarity with mature component libraries and design systems (MUI or similar).
  • Experience mentoring or leveling up other designers through example and critique.
  • Working knowledge of HTML/CSS; JavaScript a plus.
  • Degree in Design, HCI, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field — or equivalent experience.

description:

Perfil Técnico Esperado:

  • Experiência em arquitetura Big Data utilizando Databricks (Lakehouse, Unity Catalog)
  • Experiência com ambientes Azure e Microsoft Fabric (Data Factory, Synapse Analytics e Microsoft Fabric).
  • Engenharia e Processamento Distribuído: Experiência em linguagem de programação Python, SQL e PySpark, com entendimento arquitetura destruída Spark.

  • Background em BI Tradicional (Microsoft Stack): Experiência consolidada com SQL Server, SSIS e SSAS para compreender sistemas legados, garantindo integrações ou migrações seguras para a nuvem.
  • Visualização de Dados: Conhecimento da arquitetura e modelagem de dados para desenho de sugestão de dados integradas
  • Modelagem e Bancos de Dados: Fluência no trânsito entre ambientes relacionais e não-relacionais (NoSQL), garantindo o modelo adequado para cada caso de uso.
  • Metodologias Ágeis: Conhecimento dos ritos de agilidade (Scrum ou Kanban), com mensuração, alimentação (storytelling) de histórias de usuário e tarefas atribuídas as suas atividades


Escopo de Atuação

  • Traduzir requisitos funcionais e não funcionais em arquiteturas de dados modernas, escaláveis e alinhadas às necessidades do negócio.
  • Elaborar arquiteturas de referência, diagramas técnicos e propostas de solução para projetos de dados, analytics e inteligência artificial.
  • Definir estratégias de ingestão, armazenamento, processamento e consumo de dados utilizando Data Lake, Data Warehouse e arquiteturas Lakehouse.
  • Realizar modelagem de dados conceitual, lógica e física para suportar diferentes cenários analíticos e operacionais.
  • Definir e revisar estratégias de integração de dados entre sistemas corporativos, aplicações legadas e plataformas em nuvem.
  • Realizar estimativas de esforço, sizing técnico, cronogramas e dimensionamento de equipes para iniciativas de dados.
  • Elaborar estimativas e projeções de custos de infraestrutura em nuvem Azure, identificando oportunidades de otimização financeira e tecnológica.
  • Apoiar a definição de padrões arquiteturais relacionados à segurança, governança, qualidade e acesso aos dados.
  • Avaliar novas tecnologias e soluções do mercado, recomendando sua adoção quando houver ganhos reais de eficiência, escalabilidade ou redução de custos.
  • Atuar como referência técnica para equipes de Engenharia de Dados, Analytics, BI e Desenvolvimento.
  • Conduzir apresentações técnicas e executivas para stakeholders, traduzindo conceitos complexos em benefícios de negócio.

  • Engenharia e Processamento Distribuído: Experiência em linguagem de programação Python, SQL e PySpark, com entendimento arquitetura destruída Spark.
  • Arquitetura e Estimativa: Proficiência no desenho de arquiteturas de dados escaláveis e estimativas de esforço desenvolvimento e custos Nuvem (calculadora do Azure), projetar custos de infraestrutura e otimizar workloads.
  • Background em BI Tradicional (Microsoft Stack): Experiência consolidada com SQL Server, SSIS e SSAS para compreender sistemas legados, garantindo integrações ou migrações seguras para a nuvem.
  • Visualização de Dados: Conhecimento da arquitetura e modelagem de dados para desenho de sugestão de dados integradas
  • Modelagem e Bancos de Dados: Fluência no trânsito entre ambientes relacionais e não-relacionais (NoSQL), garantindo o modelo adequado para cada caso de uso.
  • Metodologias Ágeis: Conhecimento dos ritos de agilidade (Scrum ou Kanban), com mensuração, alimentação (storytelling) de histórias de usuário e tarefas atribuídas as suas atividades


Escopo de Atuação

  • Conduzir workshops de discovery e levantamento de requisitos junto às áreas de negócio, compreendendo desafios, necessidades e oportunidades relacionadas a dados e analytics.
  • Traduzir requisitos funcionais e não funcionais em arquiteturas de dados modernas, escaláveis e alinhadas às necessidades do negócio.
  • Elaborar arquiteturas de referência, diagramas técnicos e propostas de solução para projetos de dados, analytics e inteligência artificial.
  • Definir estratégias de ingestão, armazenamento, processamento e consumo de dados utilizando Data Lake, Data Warehouse e arquiteturas Lakehouse.
  • Realizar modelagem de dados conceitual, lógica e física para suportar diferentes cenários analíticos e operacionais.
  • Definir e revisar estratégias de integração de dados entre sistemas corporativos, aplicações legadas e plataformas em nuvem.
  • Realizar estimativas de esforço, sizing técnico, cronogramas e dimensionamento de equipes para iniciativas de dados.
  • Elaborar estimativas e projeções de custos de infraestrutura em nuvem Azure, identificando oportunidades de otimização financeira e tecnológica.
  • Apoiar a definição de padrões arquiteturais relacionados à segurança, governança, qualidade e acesso aos dados.
  • Avaliar novas tecnologias e soluções do mercado, recomendando sua adoção quando houver ganhos reais de eficiência, escalabilidade ou redução de custos.
  • Atuar como referência técnica para equipes de Engenharia de Dados, Analytics, BI e Desenvolvimento.
  • Conduzir apresentações técnicas e executivas para stakeholders, traduzindo conceitos complexos em benefícios de negócio.

title: TikTok Creator Community Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para TikTok Creator Community Manager em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Zainith Agency is a marketing agency specializing in TikTok Shop onboarding, paid advertising, and consulting for branding and web page design. With over 6 years of experience managing successful eCommerce brands, we help businesses grow through tailored digital marketing strategies and strategic affiliate partnerships. Our services also include design and affiliate curation, making us a trusted partner for brands looking to enhance their social commerce presence.


Job Description


Zainith Agency is looking for a TikTok Shop Creator Community Manager to join our team remotely. While this position is remote, Zainith Agency is headquartered in New York City, USA.


IMPORTANT: Applications from candidates who are not fluent in English, do not give their resume in English, or do not have proven TikTok Shop knowledge will be immediately disqualified. No exceptions.


The Community Manager will operate as the primary point of contact with top TikTok Shop creators making content for Zainith Agency’s clients. The focus of this role is to build and maintain strong relationships with creators and grow Zainith Agency’s discord community by offering training, biweekly calls, contests and prizes, and more!


You will be responsible for:

  • Managing creators on TikTok Shop Seller Center and discord orWhatsApp groups (10-12)
  • Meeting one-on-one with top creators and building relationships
  • Hosting contests, workshops, office hours, etc. within discord to keep creators engaged
  • Recruiting TikTok Shop affiliates to join and be active in our discord community
  • Growing the number of creators within the community as well as the collective GMV driven by the community through TAP links


The ideal candidate has a proven track record in account management, eCommerce, and client satisfaction. You should have multiple examples of going above and beyond to meet client expectations.


Responsibilities

  • Meet targets for discord membership growth and GMV driven
  • Host biweekly call to keep creators engaged and driven
  • Moderate discord or WhatsApp chats and engage regularly with members
  • Answer questions related to TikTok Shop and Zainith Agency’s services for creators
  • Manage and promote affiliate contests with prizes and payouts
  • Add and remove client brands from affiliate group and ensure top creators are being onboarded to the community


Requirements

  • MUST have proven experience with TikTok Shop (Seller Central, Ads Manager, affiliates, etc)
  • Self-starter comfortable with developing a program from scratch with little direction or oversight.
  • Fluency in English (written and spoken at a professional level)
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Excellent listening, negotiation, and presentation abilities
  • Previous eCommerce experience
  • Ability to manage multiple client accounts with sharp attention to detail
  • Demonstrated ability to influence and communicate with stakeholders at all levels, including executives
  • Reliable high-speed internet connection that supports live video meetings with screen sharing



About Zainith Agency

Zainith Agency is a New York–based marketing agency dedicated to helping clients achieve peak growth on TikTok Shop. The “zenith” represents the highest point, and Zainith is committed to scaling and maintaining sales growth for every client.


We've worked with several high revenue powerhouses such as Momofuku, Obvi, Primal Harvest, Kinobody, and more!


We foster a culture of excellence, flexibility, and growth.


Benefits include:

  • Paid time off

title: MES Business Analyst(Aveva)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para MES Business Analyst(Aveva) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Job Summary:

  • Our client is looking for a MES Global Business Analyst. Needs to have senior level MES skills, with at least 1 Aveva project. Focus is more from the business side but needs to be able to interact with the technical team and will need some hands on Aveva experience.
  • This role supports a large-scale MES program across 26 sites, acting as a global business system owner with strong functional accountability for harmonizing manufacturing processes, shaping MES capabilities, and ensuring business alignment across implementations.


Responsibilities

  • Collect user requirements from sites and drive standardization and harmonization of MES-supported manufacturing processes
  • Support the definition of core MES data structures such as Master batch records, materials, resources, and master data
  • Review functional solution design proposed by the system integrator and escalate gaps, risks, or misalignment with business needs
  • Monitor and control solution definition across multiple parallel implementations to ensure consistency of core MES functions
  • Oversee UAT preparation and execution, ensuring test scenarios adequately cover critical manufacturing and compliance processes
  • Assess change impacts at site level, including process adoption, training needs, and local operational readiness
  • Production of project status reports and functional progress updates for MES deployments
  • Escalation management for process, design, and deployment issues affecting MES implementation
  • Coordination of cross-functional teams involved in MES design, testing, and rollout
  • Support global business activities related to manufacturing execution, electronic batch records, and process standardization
  • Support the global business application owner in functional maintenance, enhancement prioritization, and solution testing and governance


Required Qualifications

  • At least 5-7 years of experience in OT/IT projects within manufacturing, including significant exposure to MES implementation as a business representative or functional lead
  • Strong functional understanding of MES capabilities such as electronic batch records, recipe/workflow execution, material traceability, review by exception, and equipment status management
  • Experience translating site business needs into user requirements, process flows, and harmonized global solutions
  • Experience in GxP-regulated environments, ideally within pharmaceutical manufacturing
  • Good knowledge of pharma manufacturing processes, including batch execution, dispensing, weighing, and quality-related process controls
  • Experience working in Agile or hybrid project delivery models is preferred
  • Experience in MES implementation projects within regulated manufacturing environments, ideally in Pharma
  • Functional exposure to MES-related capabilities such as eBR, batch execution, material genealogy, deviation handling, review by exception, and integration with ERP/LIMS/warehouse systems

Musts:

title: AI Curriculum Designer & Developer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para AI Curriculum Designer & Developer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

AI Curriculum Designer & Developer


Role Details

Position: AI Curriculum Designer & Developer

Commitment: Full-Time (40 Hours/Week)

Location: Remote

Work Schedule: Overlap with U.S. business hours preferred


About Us

Talent Global connects high-performing remote professionals with fast-growing international companies. We focus on long-term partnerships, cultural alignment, and helping exceptional talent thrive in impactful roles.


Role Overview

We are looking for an AI Curriculum Designer & Developer to join a fast-growing education-focused organization creating engaging learning experiences for K-12 students.

This is a highly AI-driven curriculum development role that combines educational expertise, creativity, project leadership, and technology. The ideal candidate has experience designing curriculum, lessons, educational content, or learning experiences for children and is passionate about leveraging AI to improve how educational content is created, refined, and delivered.

The successful candidate will lead curriculum development projects, collaborate with cross-functional teams, and actively incorporate advanced AI tools and workflows into the content creation process. We are looking for someone who embraces innovation, enjoys experimenting with new technologies, and views AI as a core part of their daily workflow rather than simply a supporting tool.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design and develop engaging curriculum, lessons, educational content, and learning experiences for K-12 learners
  • Create learning objectives, instructional materials, assessments, and supporting educational resources
  • Apply storytelling, age-appropriate learning strategies, and student engagement principles to curriculum development
  • Lead curriculum and content development projects from planning through final delivery
  • Collaborate with curriculum, content, product, design, and technical teams
  • Leverage AI tools and workflows to improve content quality, efficiency, scalability, and personalization
  • Evaluate and adopt emerging AI technologies relevant to curriculum design and educational content creation
  • Help optimize and refine AI-assisted curriculum development processes
  • Ensure educational content meets high standards of quality, accuracy, clarity, and learner engagement
  • Manage timelines, priorities, and deliverables across multiple projects


Must-Have Requirements

  • Fluent English speaker with excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • 3+ years of experience in curriculum design, instructional design, education, learning experience design, or educational content development
  • Experience developing curriculum, lessons, or educational materials for K-12 learners
  • Experience leading curriculum, instructional design, or educational content projects
  • Strong understanding of learning science, instructional design principles, and child-centered education
  • Demonstrated experience incorporating AI into curriculum development or content creation workflows
  • Experience using AI tools beyond basic prompting and content generation
  • Strong project management, organization, and stakeholder communication skills
  • Comfortable working independently in a remote environment
  • Strong curiosity for emerging technologies and AI-driven innovation


Nice-to-Have Requirements

  • Experience in EdTech, curriculum publishing, or digital learning environments
  • Experience developing educational books, workbooks, lesson plans, or classroom resources
  • Experience creating social-emotional learning (SEL) or character development content
  • Experience working with AI-powered content generation systems, agents, or automated workflows
  • Experience collaborating with engineering, product, or technical teams
  • Experience building scalable educational content production systems


Ideal Candidate

  • Passionate about education and creating meaningful learning experiences for children
  • Highly AI-driven and actively explores new technologies and workflows
  • Comfortable working in fast-paced, innovation-focused environments
  • Strong balance of creativity, educational expertise, and operational execution
  • Excited to lead projects and drive continuous improvement in curriculum development processes
  • Sees AI as a core component of modern educational content creation

title: Lead Product Designer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Lead Product Designer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Who are we?

Transcenda, headquartered in the US, was founded in July 2019 and is a full-lifecycle product development company. With locations throughout Romania, Poland, Ukraine, and Brazil, Transcenda works with Fortune 500 companies and well-funded startups to help bring new products to life.


Transcenda helps companies ideate new product concepts, build prototypes, design world-class solutions then engineer new commercial products. Transcenda puts people first and strives to be a changemaker by building a better world through technology. Transcenda has grown from a 5-person team to over 250 people over the past four years and plans to continue growing.


About the role

This is a senior, consultancy-style design role. You'll move between leading projects end-to-end — driving discovery, aligning stakeholders, shaping direction — and rolling up your sleeves as a senior-level individual contributor when that's what the work needs.


You'll be working on mature, live products where the bar is improving what exists: smoothing workflows, sharpening hierarchy, lifting conversion, and removing friction. This is not a greenfield, portfolio-piece role. If you get satisfaction from making a working product noticeably better for the people who use it every day, you'll like it here.



Key responsibilities

  • Take ownership of design problems on assigned projects — frame the problem, drive it through discovery, design, and delivery, and bring stakeholders along the whole way.
  • Lead or contribute on a project depending on what's needed — sometimes you're directing the design effort, sometimes you're the one in Figma producing the work. Both modes should feel comfortable.
  • Partner closely with product managers and engineers, translating ambiguous requirements into concrete, testable design solutions and iterating against live implementations.
  • Run the iterative cycle from low-fidelity exploration through high-fidelity delivery, with usability validation at the points where it actually changes the outcome.
  • Facilitate workshops, design reviews, and working sessions with cross-functional and executive stakeholders. Make decisions visible and trade-offs explicit.
  • Mentor and raise the bar for designers around you.
  • Build durable relationships with stakeholders. Understand what they're actually trying to achieve and push back constructively when the brief is wrong.


Must haves

  • 6–10+ years of UX/Product Design experience, ideally including time in a consultancy, agency, or embedded-team setting where you've owned client or stakeholder relationships directly.
  • Demonstrated ability to flex between leading a project (or a small team) and contributing as a senior IC, depending on what the engagement needs.
  • Track record of improving existing products rather than designing greenfield experiences — measurable wins on usability, conversion, or workflow efficiency.
  • Strong visual and UI judgment for forms, workflows, CTAs, hierarchy, and layout. You can defend a layout decision on the merits.
  • Comfort working closely with engineering against live implementations — you can read a real interface and tell us what's wrong with it before opening Figma.
  • Ability to articulate why a design decision was made and what problem it solves, to audiences ranging from engineers to executives.
  • Experience facilitating cross-functional workshops and leading business reviews or strategic planning sessions with senior stakeholders.


Nice to have

  • Background designing for regulated or enterprise domains (finance, compliance, GRC, banking, or similar).
  • Experience designing software embedded inside third-party platforms.
  • Familiarity with mature component libraries and design systems (MUI or similar).
  • Experience mentoring or leveling up other designers through example and critique.
  • Working knowledge of HTML/CSS; JavaScript a plus.
  • Degree in Design, HCI, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field — or equivalent experience.

title: Business Analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Business Analyst em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Job Responsibilities:

Job Title: Global Trade Compliance Business Analyst

Introduction: We are seeking an experienced Global Trade Compliance Business Analyst to join our team and play a critical role in supporting the business across a broad spectrum of global import and export compliance matters. This position is vital in ensuring our compliance with international trade regulations while enabling data-driven decision-making through the creation of innovative dashboards and reports. The successful candidate will leverage their expertise in global trade compliance and advanced analytics tools to model the potential impact of tariffs on the business model and drive continuous improvement in compliance processes.

Roles and Responsibilities:

  • Collaborate with regional trade compliance teams and business stakeholders to gather, document, and refine business requirements and functional processes, adapting them as business needs evolve.
  • Maintain and oversee day-to-day global classification processes to support global import volumes, ensuring accuracy and compliance.
  • Assist with technology, hardware, and software trade classification, including management of Harmonized Tariff Schedule (HTS) , Schedule B , and Export Control Classification Number (ECCN) classifications.
  • Manage compliance activities equally focused on imports and exports (50% each).
  • Develop and contribute to documented classification justifications based on the General Rules of Interpretation (GRI) foundation for global import classifications.
  • Provide import compliance guidance in adherence to US and international regulations, including conducting research, updating status reports, and coordinating deliverables within the team.
  • Build, maintain, and analyze data-informed metrics to generate actionable insights that enhance the global trade compliance program.
  • Establish and nurture positive business relationships with key stakeholders and cross-functional teams.
  • Engage with software development teams to understand and influence evolving compliance technology, identifying opportunities to automate manual processes.
  • Generate and contribute to performance requirements, timelines, and metrics for all related activities.
  • Support project management efforts to ensure timely delivery of team assignments and objectives.


Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain, Logistics, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience as a Business Analyst, preferably within supply chain, logistics, or global trade compliance environments.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to produce clear documentation including Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and detailed reports.
  • Proven experience with global trade compliance regulations, including import/export laws and logistics preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently research and dive deep into complex compliance requests and issues.


Tools and Technologies:

  • Proficient in Smartsheet , Power BI , and AWS Quicksight with hands-on experience creating new dashboards, running data batches, and developing meaningful metrics and reports.
  • Strong data analytics and data entry skills to support compliance reporting and insights generation.
  • Familiarity with trade classification tools and regulatory databases is a plus.


Skills:

Global trade compliance, Smartsheet, Power BI, AWS Quicksight

title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer, AI-Native
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Full-Stack Engineer, AI-Native em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Zaigo builds AI software for real businesses.
Not demos. Not slide decks. Actual tools that people use to run parts of their company.
Our clients are usually owner-led or mid-market companies in the US: professional services firms, distributors, manufacturers, healthcare operators, finance teams. They have messy workflows, old systems, weird data, and very little patience for theory. We figure out what should exist, then we build it.
We are looking for a senior full-stack engineer who already builds heavily with AI. Someone who can take a vague client problem, turn it into a product plan, build the thing, polish it, ship it, and keep moving.
If you need perfect specs, this probably is not the job. If you like owning the whole problem and moving faster than normal teams think is reasonable, it might be.
What the work looks like
You will own client projects end to end.
That means you may be on a call with a business owner in the morning, designing the workflow after lunch, and shipping the first usable version that week. The work is full-stack product engineering: database, backend, UI, auth, integrations, AI agents, evals, error handling, deployment, and the judgment to know what should not be handled by a model.
Recent Zaigo-style projects include:
a document review tool that checks presentations against a firm's brand and compliance rules
a benchmarking platform built from years of public company filings
payroll and operations tools that clean messy data and produce files people can actually use
internal AI agents that help teams move faster without giving the model dangerous autonomy
You do not need to be an ML researcher. You do need to be a very strong engineer who knows how to use AI tools to ship better and faster.
Who we are looking for
You are probably a fit if this sounds like you:
You have 5+ years building software professionally.
You can ship across the stack: frontend, backend, database, integrations, deployment.
You use AI coding tools every day, not as a novelty. Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, agents, worktrees, parallel terminals, your own setup. We care less about the exact tools and more about whether you have real opinions from using them.
You think like a product owner. You ask what the user is trying to do, what the first useful version should be, and what will make people trust the system.
You can work with ambiguity. Clients rarely hand you perfect requirements.
You have taste. There is no reason to ship ugly software anymore.
You communicate clearly in English and can talk through tradeoffs with US clients.
You have high initiative. You fix things nobody assigned. You build outside work because you like building.
Bonus points if you have founded something, freelanced, run a small agency, built your own product, or worked directly with clients.
Who should not apply
This is probably not the right role if you want a narrow lane, a long roadmap, and fully written tickets.
It is also probably not right if your AI experience is mostly prompting ChatGPT, building toy demos, or talking about agents without shipping production software.
We need builders. Smart, fast, practical builders.
Process
Short application.
10-minute async voice interview.
Live interview with Zaigo's founder.
Short practical build project.
Offer if it is a fit.
We move quickly. If there is a fit, you will hear from us within days, not weeks.
